description: This file defines the AttendeeScheduledEmail class, which extends BaseEmail to generate and send email notifications for scheduled calendar events to attendees, including generating ICS files, email content, and formatting date/time information.

classes.name: AttendeeScheduledEmail
classes.description: A class for creating and managing attendee scheduled email notifications, including email content generation, ICS file creation, and date/time formatting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the email with calendar event, attendee, and optional showAttendees flag.

methods.name: getNodeMailerPayload
methods.description: Prepares the email payload with ICS attachment, recipient, sender, reply-to, subject, HTML content, and text body.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the email using renderEmail.

methods.name: getTextBody
methods.description: Creates the plain text version of the email body with event details.

methods.name: getInviteeStart
methods.description: Formats the start time of the event for the attendee.

methods.name: getInviteeEnd
methods.description: Formats the end time of the event for the attendee.

methods.name: getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns the full formatted date and time string for the event.
